name: Mi Lluvia Personalizada
description: Formación competitiva Defensivo (Stall) de 6 miembros. Debilidades compartidas: Ninguna crítica.

members.name: Pelipper
members.pokedex: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.

members.name: Swampert
members.pokedex: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

members.name: Zapdos
members.pokedex: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.

members.name: Scizor
members.pokedex: A Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.

members.name: Kingdra
members.pokedex: It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor. When it comes up to the surface, it creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow even ships.

members.name: Ferrothorn
members.pokedex: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

name: Stall Añil (Muro Infranqueable)
description: Alineación ultra defensiva orientada a desgastar al rival por daño residual, trampas y regeneración pasiva. Muro físico con Garchomp y Toxapex, muro especial con Chansey y Corviknight, e inmunidades clave a Tierra, Fuego y Eléctrico.

members.name: Garchomp
members.pokedex: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

members.name: Corviknight
members.pokedex: No tiene rival en los cielos. El acero negro y lustroso de su cuerpo intimida a cualquier adversario.

members.name: Toxapex
members.pokedex: It crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

members.name: Chansey
members.pokedex: Chansey lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those who have lost their appetite.

members.name: Gliscor
members.pokedex: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

members.name: Ferrothorn
members.pokedex: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

name: Bulky Balance (Meta Sólido)
description: Estructura competitiva balanceada con capacidad de absorber golpes y responder con daño masivo. Heatran y Clefable frenan atacantes especiales, Slowbro y Corviknight neutralizan atacantes físicos, y Garchomp y Weavile rematan la partida.

members.name: Garchomp
members.pokedex: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

members.name: Heatran
members.pokedex: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

members.name: Clefable
members.pokedex: A Clefable uses its wings to skip lightly as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.

members.name: Weavile
members.pokedex: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

members.name: Slowbro
members.pokedex: Its tail has a Shellder firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.

members.name: Corviknight
members.pokedex: No tiene rival en los cielos. El acero negro y lustroso de su cuerpo intimida a cualquier adversario.
